call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth expected across payments, financial services and wealth, with marketing services also contributing.
Indirect costs are expected to grow significantly lower than revenue and contribution profit, giving operating leverage.
Merchant loan penetration is about 7% of subscription merchants, up from about 6% a year earlier.
Merchant lending growth has come roughly equally from base expansion, penetration and ticket size, about 15% each.
Wealth, including retail broking, is positioned as the third leg of growth alongside payments and financial services.
Management said it is not pursuing an NBFC licence, preferring to distribute for multiple partner lenders.
Any new investment will be only in AI; no material capital investment plan is on the table.
Next year EBITDA is expected to be significantly higher than capex.
Management declined to give disbursement numbers or a Postpaid disbursal guidance.
On the PPBL ban, management said there is no impact on the listed entity and it remains committed.
More than half of card machines are enabled for EMI disbursal, spanning electronics, healthcare and other categories.

operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 monitoring report shows ₹1,986 Cr unutilized IPO proceeds invested in bank deposits.
Merchant loan penetration was about 7% of subscription merchants, up from about 6% a year earlier.
Merchant lending growth has come roughly equally from base expansion, penetration and ticket size, about 15% each.
More than half of card machines are enabled for EMI disbursal.
Paytm Pocket Money caps individual UPI payments at ₹5,000 and monthly spends at ₹15,000, with ₹500 allowed in the first 30 minutes and ₹5,000 in the first 24 hours after setup.
Paytm Europe Payments S.A. was incorporated in Luxembourg on January 12, 2026 and is yet to commence business.
Approved DLG of up to ₹90 Cr each with Muthoot Fincorp and Kisetsu Saison Finance.
Net payment margin was 8.4 bps in Q1FY27 versus 8.8 bps a year earlier, with payment processing costs at 11.2 bps versus 10.6 bps.
The company has a double-digit number of lending partners in both merchant and personal loans, with partner capital 4-6 times current disbursements.
Paytm Postpaid is tracking roughly twice as fast as the previous ramp, which took about 4.5-5 years to reach ₹9,000 Cr.
First Games received a GST demand order of ₹703.66 Cr for Apr 2018-Mar 2023 with nil financial impact on Paytm.

timeline.summary: One 97 Communications informed exchanges that RBI cancelled PPBL's banking license, with no financial or business impact on the company.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,264 Cr (+18.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹184 Cr (against a loss of ₹539.8 Cr a year earlier).
On 2026-05-06, One 97 Communications filed the monitoring agency report for Q4FY26 showing ₹1,986 Cr of unutilized IPO proceeds.
One 97 Communications filed the transcript of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call held on May 07, 2026.
2026-05-18: One 97 Communications launched Paytm Pocket Money, letting teenagers make Paytm UPI payments without a bank account under parental limits via NPCI's UPI Circle.
Paytm announced an additional investment of EUR 9 million in its step-down subsidiary, Paytm Europe Payments S.A.
Paytm approved up to ₹90 Cr DLG arrangements with lending partners and noted the withdrawal of Independent Director Ashit Lilani's reappointment.
On its July 21, 2026 Q1FY27 earnings call, Paytm said it has higher confidence of reaching its 15-20% EBITDA margin band sooner, after margin adjusted for PIDF rose to 8% from 1% a year earlier.
Paytm updated that NPCI deferred the implementation of MDR on select UPI P2M transactions until after Diwali.
Subsidiary First Games Technology received a reduced GST demand order of ₹703.66 Cr for FY19-23 with no incremental impact on Paytm.
One 97 Communications Limited scheduled a **Board Meeting** on **October 26, 2026**, to approve unaudited Q2FY27 and H1FY27 results.
